name: Video monitoring
description: Camera register on the map, audited viewing sessions (every viewing states a purpose), references to recordings held by an external video management system with retention and legal hold, and markers that link moments to incidents. TITAN does not store, stream or analyse video.

roles.name: Security operator
roles.description: Watches cameras, maintains the camera register and marks moments for incidents

lifecycle.on_deactivate: The video capability is withdrawn: the camera register, viewing log, recording references and markers are kept but cannot be read or changed until it is active again.
